court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Respondent: Mr. M. Karthikeyan Additional Government Pleader
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

P.D. Audikesavalu, J.:— When it is pointed out that the nature of relief sought by the Petitioner in his representation dated 06.08.2018 could not be granted by the Respondent, Learned Counsel for the Petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the Writ Petition with liberty to work out his remedy before the proper forum for necessary relief in accordance with law and he has made an endorsement to that effect, which is recorded.

2. Recording the same, the Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn granting such liberty. No costs.
